adjudication.rationale: In `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#update` and `#destroy`, the diff shows `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` with no nil-check. If the id is unknown, `host` is `nil`, and `save_host(host)` will call `host.host = ...` / `host.category_id = ...`, and `destroy` will call `host.destroy`, both causing `NoMethodError` (500). Additionally, `save_host` directly dereferences `params[:embeddable_host][:host]` and `[:category_id]`, which will also raise if the `embeddable_host` key is missing, rather than returning a 4xx error.
